description: Full-size replica of a Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX carrying British Aviation Preservation Council number BAPC.268; built with some original wartime components. Not an original airframe. At the Hangar 42 Spitfire Visitor Centre, home of the Lytham Spitfire Display Team, in the south hangar at Blackpool Airport.

Replica Supermarine Spitfire cockpit section carrying British Aviation Preservation Council number BAPC.523; visitors are seated in it for photographs. Not an original airframe. At the Hangar 42 Spitfire Visitor Centre, home of the Lytham Spitfire Display Team, in the south hangar at Blackpool Airport.
